sources.3023: C# (.cs)|Classes, records, interfaces and services.|create a C# class BankAccount with Deposit and Withdraw methods
sources.3024: SQL, JSON, HTML, Markdown, TXT|Scripts, configuration files, pages and texts. Write the extension (.sql, .json, .html, .md, .txt) in the request.|generate a .sql script that creates the customers table with id, name and e-mail
sources.3025: Documents: PDF, DOCX, ODT, RTF (Word)|Summaries and reports, also from the open file.|summarize the open file in PDF
sources.3026: Go (.go)|Packages, structs and functions.|write a Go program (.go) that counts the lines of a text file
sources.3027: Java (.java)|Classes, interfaces and enums. One public class per file, with the same name as the file.|create a Java class Product with name and price, getters and setters
sources.3028: JavaScript (.js)|Classes, functions and Node.js scripts. Say "JavaScript" or ".js".|create a JavaScript function that validates an e-mail address
sources.3029: C / C++, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift|Generated the same way (.cpp, .c, .rs, .php, .rb, .kt, .swift), but not validated yet.|write a C++ function that reverses a string
sources.3030: Delphi / Pascal (.pas, .dpr, .inc)|Units, classes, procedures and functions.|create a Delphi unit with a function that formats a phone number
sources.3031: Python (.py)|Scripts, classes and functions. To transform the lines of the open file, use the Python macro (Ctrl+Alt+E) instead.|generate a Python script that reads a CSV file and sums the value column
sources.3032: React (.tsx) and JSX (.jsx)|Components and hooks. "React" produces .tsx; ask for ".jsx" for plain JavaScript.|generate a React component for a to-do list in TSX
sources.3033: TypeScript / Angular (.ts)|Interfaces, types, classes and services. Say "TypeScript", "Angular" or ".ts".|create a TypeScript interface Customer and a class CustomerService with add and find methods
sources.3034: The AI Assistant (Ctrl+Alt+A) writes a complete source file from your request and saves it in the fastfile_assistant folder. Then it can check the syntax and, if there are errors, fix the file with the AI. Double-click an example to put it in the question box.
sources.3035: Running and building|The code is never run and FastFile does not build projects (no package.json, tsconfig, Maven, npm install, tests or formatting). It creates one file per request.|
sources.3036: Languages without validation|C / C++, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift and Delphi / Pascal are generated but not validated yet.|
sources.3037: One file at a time|Java and C# are checked alone, so references to other classes of your project can show up as errors. JSON / HTML / SQL checks are structural only.|

sources.3051: How to validate|Use the validate button on the card of the generated file, or ask in the question box with the full path. Without a path, a window opens to pick the file.|validate the syntax of C:\temp\script.py
sources.3052: Java (.java)|Uses javac from the JDK installed on this PC (PATH, JAVA_HOME or the usual folders). It compiles into a temporary folder, so type errors are reported too. Without a JDK, FastFile says so and does not validate.|

sources.3054: JSON, HTML, SQL (.json, .html, .htm, .sql)|Checked by FastFile itself, no extra program: full JSON syntax; HTML tags opened and closed; SQL quotes, comments, parentheses and BEGIN/CASE...END blocks.|validate the syntax of C:\data\config.json
